statements.t: We expect these conditions to continue to affect our business.

These disruptions impacted our results during the first nine months of 2026 and, given the continued uncertainty regarding the duration and scope of the conflict, we expect these conditions to continue to adversely affect the EMEA region for the remainder of 2026.

We expect to incur total pre-tax costs of approximately $80 million to $90 million, which consist primarily of one-time termination benefits, including cash severance payments, healthcare benefits, and related transition assistance.
The reprioritization of our R&D efforts is yielding new, differentiated products for our customers, and our progress gives us confidence in our 2026 outlook.”

For the full-year 2026, the Company continues to expect non-GAAP, currency-neutral revenue to be in the range of a decline of approximately 3.0 percent to growth of approximately 0.5 percent, and an estimated non-GAAP operating margin of approximately 10.0 to 12.0 percent.
Management will discuss the Company’s third quarter 2026 results and financial outlook in a conference call scheduled for 2:00 PM Pacific Time (5:00 PM Eastern Time) on November 4, 2026.
